method: compare-images.py: TCGdex low.webp (245x337) vs official tw<id>.png, both resized to 48x66 RGB, mean absolute pixel difference (0-1) and 16x16 dHash Hamming distance; images fetched one per 1.6 s into a scratch folder and not stored in the repo
rule: matched when best pixel distance < 0.02, the other >= 3x best, official-vs-official pixel distance >= 0.03, and dHash agrees by >= 20 bits; otherwise ambiguous (left unsplit)
